tactics:
induction j generalizing l with
  | zero => simp only [List.drop_zero, Nat.zero_add]
  | succ n ih => cases l with
    | nil => simp only [List.drop_nil]
    | cons a t => rw [Nat.add_right_comm n 1 i]; simp only [List.drop_succ_cons]; exact ih t
induction j generalizing l <;> cases l <;> simp_all [-List.drop_drop, Nat.add_right_comm _ 1]
